cohort: The study population included 16,759,786 hospital deliveries in the United States between 2016 and 2020, with patients having other mental health conditions excluded.
finding: The prevalence of ADHD in pregnant patients in the United States increased from 2016 to 2020 and was associated with younger age, White race, asthma, and substance use disorders, though severe maternal morbidity was similar between ADHD and non-ADHD groups.
mod_finding: Rates of cesarean delivery were only modestly increased in patients with ADHD.
